data.desc: Creative Medical Technology Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: CELZ) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering regenerative medicine therapies derived from adult and perinatal stem cell technologies. The Company's pipeline targets large, underserved markets across orthopedics, immunotherapy, endocrinology, urology and gynecology, with a mission to deliver scalable, disease-modifying solutions for patients with high unmet medical needs.
